summary: The current segmenter over-fragments causal/conditional chains and cuts ambiguous entities or modifiers away from their disambiguating context, damaging translation quality; simultaneously it leaves many long sentences fully unsplit even when a discourse marker, reason clause, or punctuation boundary offers a free latency gain. Both errors stem from not distinguishing clause-completeness boundaries from arbitrary connective endings.
